purpose: Evaluate parameter-matched and unmodified controls, segment-preserving topology perturbations, distance-binned gradient transport, and Apple MPS runtime/memory diagnostics.
limitations: Synthetic algorithmic task only; no natural-language capability claim.
Six seeds and 80 updates remain a screening experiment, not a confirmatory study.
Training remains CPU-based; Apple MPS is measured for inference and candidate search only.
MPS current/driver allocation is sampled every 2 ms; sampling can miss shorter peaks and is not an exact per-model peak measurement.
MPS current/driver allocation peaks are sampled every 2 ms and can miss shorter spikes.
Host RSS peak is sampled every 2 ms and may miss shorter spikes; phase deltas include runtime state and are not isolated tensor allocations.
CPU profiler allocation sum and whole-process peak RSS are not per-model peak memory.
The parameter-matched control widens the Transformer feed-forward layer; parameter count matches but FLOPs and inductive bias do not.
Synthetic packed recurrence uses two independent causal segments; no natural-language capability claim.
